patches.why: STRUCTURAL RECOVERY, read at the plate 2026-09-16 (prep spot check). Migne sets a display heading above this work and Corpus Corporum drops the whole line; our TEI body opened at CC's own catalogue title, which Migne does not print. Same class as the five Glossa Pentateuch book-title lines (Wilson's ruling 2026-09-06), encoded by the same convention: <head type="book-title"> above the first head, before the first column mark, so col is null. Witness: Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w, map f = (column + 1) / 2 (corners read FIRST: f6 = 11/12, f13 = 25/26, f15 = 29/30, f17 = 33/34, f18 = 35/36); this heading on f6 (cols 11/12). Transcribed with ae for the ligature as the TEI does; Migne's capitals, small capitals and italics are not encoded. The heading stands immediately under Migne's own MONITUM EDITORIS PATROLOGIAE (cols 11A-B), which is Migne's editorial notice and NOT part of this work. ⚑ The 1617 Douai Prolegomena continue past this letter: cols 20C-25B (DE CANONICIS ET NON CANONICIS LIBRIS, then a section on the ancient translations) are in no Corpus Corporum file.

Digitization defect. Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w f8 (corners 15/16), right column: final sort worn into a z-like shape; archive patrologiaecurs04migngoog p.13 (15/16) prints petulantia clean. Plate-read by stint A, 2026-09-16; corner numbers read FIRST on every leaf cited.

Digitization defect. Both witnesses print poeta: Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w f9 (17/18) left column, t worn; archive patrologiaecurs04migngoog p.14 (17/18) clean. English already reads "a poet". Plate-read by stint A, 2026-09-16; corner numbers read FIRST on every leaf cited.

Digitization defect. archive patrologiaecurs04migngoog p.14 (17/18) prints elucidans clean; Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w f9 (17/18) right column band D shows a worn e with the bar gone, which the digitization read as c. The two witnesses point the same way (a worn e is not a c), so applied (orchestrator ruling 2026-09-16). Plate-read by stint A, 2026-09-16; corner numbers read FIRST on every leaf cited. Column label is the band our TEI anchors carry at the find (0018C); the stint cited the plate band (0018D).

Digitization defect. Both witnesses print nonnullis: Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w f10 (19/20) left column line 2; archive patrologiaecurs04migngoog p.15 (19/20). Plate-read by stint A, 2026-09-16; corner numbers read FIRST on every leaf cited.
